title: W01 to W08 Creator Qualification API Internal HTTP Binding

callee.authority: Creator applications and creator identity facts on D1-01

operations.bodyAuthority: Only action, resourceType, and resourceAttributes are accepted; W08 resolves actor, layer, account state, and roles through W02/D1-01 and CASL.

W01 sends only action, resourceType and resourceAttributes. W08 independently resolves the actor, account state, layer and scoped roles through W02/D1-01. Subscription ownership is compared against the W02 subject; client-supplied subject/layer/account-state/permission fields are rejected.

operations.audit: decision actor, reason, timestamp and application version are persisted by W08

operations.bodyAuthority: No client body or creator ID is accepted; W08 derives the creator ID from the W02 principal and requires an ACTIVE creator record.
creatorType and statement only; caller cannot set role, layer, decision, creator id, status, scope, or approver

trustBoundary.authentication: W01 forwards the browser session cookie or native Authorization: Bearer session credential to W08; W08 forwards the same carrier to W02_AUTH /internal/auth/principal for validation. W08 never trusts body userId or validates raw credentials locally.
trustBoundary.creatorQualification: W08 owns application/review state and creator identity
trustBoundary.roleAssignment: W02 alone writes role_assignments after authenticating the approver independently
sessionCredentialCarriers: HttpOnly Better Auth browser session cookie
Authorization: Bearer <canonical Better Auth session token>

failurePolicy.mutationRetryRule: Retry with the same Idempotency-Key; approved role grants remain PENDING until the W02 grant is confirmed
failClosed: missing If-Match on an undecided application
role grant not confirmed by W02

security.publicWorker: W08 is not directly public; all public requests enter through W01
